=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:494-496 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `_push_targets` function treats the first positional argument as the repository even when `--repo` / `--rep` was explicitly provided, causing valid pushes to be wrongly blocked.
  WHY: For `git push --repo=https://github.com/X/Y.git HEAD:feature/x`, the refspec `HEAD:feature/x` is incorrectly used as the repository name, `_resolve_push_destination` fails to map it, and the guard blocks a legitimate push.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1085-1086 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `test_unmappable_push_destination_blocks_without_lookup` test includes `"git push --repo=origin HEAD:feature/x"` and `"git push --repo origin HEAD:feature/x"` in its unmappable-destination parametrize list, although `origin` is a valid configured GitHub remote.
  WHY: Once parsing is fixed, `_resolve_push_destination("origin")` succeeds and `query_pull_requests` is called, triggering the test's `pytest.fail("no PR lookup expected")` monkeypatch.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Resolve and validate the effective push repository, query PR status for that repository and destination branch, and deny the push when the destination cannot be verified." (Linked issue #6263, also AD-1 option B: cover `--repo`, positional remote name, and push-remote config.)
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:494-496, _push_targets function
  Evidence of absence: When `--repo=<repository>` is given with positional refspecs (e.g. `git push --repo=origin HEAD:feature/x` — the exact exploit scenario from the linked issue), line 495 discards the `option_repository` value and uses the first refspec as the destination. The `option_repository` variable (captured from `--repo`/`--rep`) is only consulted when `positionals` is empty. The implementation as written checks `HEAD:feature/x` as a repository name instead of `origin`, so the destination repository named by `--repo` is never verified against PR status.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
